title: Alexandra was an amazing...
text: Alexandra was an amazing tour guide!! She was very accommodating to my mother and I and knew so much about Montserrat. We would love to do another tour with her in the near future! We also loved the fact it was a private tour with its own transportation. Highly recommend for a personal experience.
author: Miriam_D

title: A wonderful tour with Alexandra
text:
Everything was very wonderful, interesting, and educational for the whole family. 
Alexandra arrived at our hotel. The trip was very smooth and pleasant. 
Arriving at the place, she described and told about all the sights with interest. We really liked that everything was clear.
Alexandra herself is very pleasant, she speaks calmly and clearly.
We highly recommend it to everyone!
author: Max_M

title: Worth the early start for this beautiful experience
text:
It was amazing from start to finish and I would definitely recommend. The mountains and monastery are just beautiful!

Our guide, Oleksandra, was really friendly,  accommodating and knowledgeable. She gave interesting insights about the history of the monastery and how it works. 

The itinerary is well structured. I was a bit hesitant of the 8am start at first but on reflection it’s definitely the right time. It meant we avoided big crowds and were able to enjoy the space peacefully. Me and my friends are all neurodivergent so we appreciated this a lot.

title: Great day with Sergei
text: Had a great day visiting Montserrat with friends led by Sergei. He was very flexible and communicative with us. He was both friendly and knowledgeable and let us go at our own pace. Montserrat itself was incredibly beautiful and a nice change of pace from Barcelona.
author: Spencer_F

title: A wonderful experience in Montserrat thanks to Sergei! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
text:
We had an incredible experience visiting Montserrat with Sergei! From the first moment he was super kind, attentive, patient, and friendly.

The car was spacious, very comfortable, and perfect for enjoying the trip. He even had the nice gesture of offering us small bottles of water.
He shared very interesting stories and facts with us, and made the trip really pleasant and entertaining. In addition, he was very patient with us at all times, he never made us feel rushed and even helped us take photos to keep beautiful memories.
